findings: CVE-2026-71276 remains PUBLISHED at CVE.org (TuranSec CNA); GHSA-pwc8-43hr-jg4j is not withdrawn. The advisory describes a real CWE-89 in the message-readers format query path.

Complete source-to-sink: HTTP format query parameter is accepted after channel access authorization and interpolated as an unquoted table identifier into PostgreSQL/Timescale SELECT and COUNT, so a caller can terminate the FROM clause and bypass WHERE predicates.

Atomic BIC is bb39e842de28ca529c2f63eb3a2da6b55ada1d60 recovered from still-reachable PR #1295 head ac754e5358fc8a433160e90e33452d42a68a83de; main squash e326494166dab3d6373c4cadb9df1bbedd25a25b is not the BIC.
Parent 06e149e2e68d25886e7e24a2cafb47f6f20d8f5d has only hardcoded FROM senml and no format query field.

First tagged affected release in this clone is 0.12.0; 0.11.0/v0.11.0 are unaffected. Direct fix aac9461aa561c3de7aa9a0dc814ac84c602e0cf9 lands on main as squash 2726a29784926f3a097d4baa31959bcabe73447e; no tag contains the fix as of HEAD a3521125fb390917e107a2e9f62c8450eaf2b179.
